header_sentences: See Garment, Cloak, and Put on.

contexts.text: Little children seen most handsomely clothed. HH 337.
Rational truths are like a veil or clothing for spiritual truths. Explained.
The interiors of the Angels shine forth from their faces; their exteriors are represented in both their bodies and clothing; so that anyone there can know their quality from their mere clothing...
With all things mentioned in the Word, the exteriors are as a veil or dress...
No cares for clothing, etc., there.
The non-deprivation of the interior life, which is food; or of the exterior life, which is clothing, or covering. Signified.
Covering, or clothing = the support of exterior life...
To clothe in scarlet () = to instruct concerning the truths which are of the good of mutual love; thus concerning truths from a celestial origin.
They who are in the Spiritual Kingdom appear clothed.
What more do we need, said they, than food and clothing?
Covering, and clothing () = external appearances which are induced, or with which they are invested.
Necessaries; which are food, clothing, and a habitation, are put off at death, and such things are received as are like them as to the outward appearance, but not as to essence.
To be arrayed () = to be instructed in truths. AE 1222.
(The dress of the prince and his councillors. Described.)
(The dress of the male and female Angels of the most ancient Heavens. Described.)
(The dress of the Spirits of the iron age. Described.)
(The dress of a prince, and of a priest of one of the heavenly Societies. Described.)
The covering of every muscle... clothes the individual motor fibres from itself.
Unless he has first... clothed himself in a wedding garment.
In Heaven they are clothed in garments of a red colour; and after they have been initiated into the goods of the New Church, they are clothed in garments of a crimson colour...
To be clothed with these things () = the appearance in externals.
(The dress of Spirits. Described.)
